levels.name: Snowswept Sakura
levels.description: When Kamisato Ayaka's Normal or Charged Attacks deal Cryo DMG to opponents, it has a 50% chance of decreasing the CD of Kamisato Art: Hyouka by 0.3s. This effect can occur once every 0.1s.

levels.name: Blizzard Blade Seki no To
levels.description: When casting Kamisato Art: Soumetsu, unleashes 2 smaller additional Frostflake Seki no To, each dealing 20% of the original storm's DMG.

levels.name: Frostbloom Kamifubuki
levels.description: Increases the Level of Kamisato Art: Soumetsu by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

levels.name: Ebb and Flow
levels.description: Opponents damaged by Kamisato Art: Soumetsu's Frostflake Seki no To will have their DEF decreased by 30% for 6s.

levels.name: Blossom Cloud Irutsuki
levels.description: Increases the Level of Kamisato Art: Hyouka by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

levels.name: Dance of Suigetsu
levels.description: Kamisato Ayaka gains Usurahi Butou every 10s, increasing her Charged Attack DMG by 298%. This buff will be cleared 0.5s after Ayaka's Charged ATK hits an opponent, after which the timer for this ability will restart.
